SUMO, not the standard browsers build: hat.sh's v2 password path is Argon2id
(crypto_pwhash), which the standard libsodium.js build does not export.

The port's file format is hat.sh v2:
  symmetric  signature "zDKO6XYXioc" + salt(16) + header(24) + secretstream chunks
  asymmetric signature "hTWKbfoikeg" + header(24) + secretstream chunks
chunk size 64 MiB, ABYTES 17, pwhash OPSLIMIT/MEMLIMIT INTERACTIVE + ARGON2ID13.
v1 ("Encrypted Using Hat.sh") is detected and refused.

Both notices travel INSIDE the GIF as well as beside it here.
